tasks.short: Show a customer how to insert, remove, and care for contact lenses.

steps.what: Read the contact lens type for this customer
inputs: contact lens type on the practice record

steps.what: Show customers how to insert, remove, and care for their contact lenses
outputs: insertion and removal the customer practised

tasks.design: She shows insertion, removal, and care in the room. No care note is filed. The digest does not show a resident care-instruction filing this task already does, so a machine save of that note is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The demonstration is a physical act with this customer in the room, and no resident care-instruction filing is part of the task.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new is feasible here, because the work is the demonstration itself.
tasks.still_hard: Whether this person can insert the lens is visible only while she watches.
tasks.human_edge: She sees whether this customer can insert, remove, and handle the lens.
tasks.altitude: The demonstration stays hers. Nothing in the week moves.

reach.task: Practise inserting and removing the contact lens
reach.learn: The demonstration stays in the room. She does not file a care note for the customer to read later.

evidence.claim: Showing a customer how to insert and remove a contact lens is spoken work in the room. The digest does not show a resident care-instruction filing this task already does, so no file step is counted. This is model knowledge, not a measured time.

assumptions: The demonstration in the room is an internal act, not a message sent outside the organisation.
A message to the customer after the visit is not given a send step, because it is not part of every demonstration.
The lens type is already on the practice record. She reads it and does not re-key it.
No system runs, so the upkeep allowance is zero.
unknowns: After the demonstration, does she write a care note into the customer record, and how many minutes does that keying take?
research_questions: On one week of fittings, what share of this task is typing a care note another person later relies on, as against the demonstration itself?

incremental.description: No system runs on this task, so no upkeep hour is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week of contact-lens fittings. The look and the demonstration stay. A care note is not counted, because a resident filing is not shown as work she already does.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare the work order and grind instructions for a pair of eyeglasses.

steps.what: Read the written prescription for this pair
inputs: written prescription on the practice record
pupil distance from the measuring task
segment height from the measuring task
frame model from the measuring task

steps.what: State the lens material, the coating, and the finishing instructions
Prepare work orders and instructions for grinding lenses and fabricating eyeglasses
Check the drafted order matches the powers and the frame she stated
Send the accepted work order to the grinding laboratory

tasks.design: The practice record in {OTHER} already holds the prescription and the measurements. A form copies those fields, plus the material, coating, and instruction she stated, onto a draft work order. The draft does not wait for her check. If sphere, cylinder, axis, eye, material, or pupil distance is blank, the form produces no order and she finishes it in the check. She checks every power, the pupil distance, the material, the coating, and that the finishing instruction still means what she decided. {PARTNER_PORTAL} then sends only that accepted order to the laboratory outside the shop. She does not also type the order by hand, and the order is not filed again as a note.
tasks.previous_blocker: The order mixed her choice of material and finishing with retyping powers that were already on the record, and a wrong power harms the wearer.
tasks.enabler_now: The prescription and the measurements are already stored as fields, so a form can copy them onto the work order without a model.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong power harms the wearer, so she still checks every order before it leaves.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the material and the finishing, and she will not release a power that differs from the prescription.
tasks.altitude: She still decides the grind and still releases the order. She no longer retypes powers that were already on the record.

reach.task: Grind and fabricate the eyeglasses from the accepted work order
reach.learn: The order arrives once, and only after she accepts it.

reach.task: Record pupil distance, segment height, and frame model
reach.learn: Those fields are already on the practice record, so this task does not measure them again.

evidence.claim: Copying already-recorded powers and the material, coating, and finishing instruction she stated onto a laboratory work order is a deterministic records step. She still checks every power. No time figure is taken from imaging or pharmacy cases. This is model knowledge.
The form only copies numbers and instructions she already stated. It does not set the prescription. This is model knowledge.
Health data are a special category.
The dossier is kept for 20 years, and the patient may ask who viewed it.

assumptions: The laboratory is a supplier outside the shop, so sending the accepted work order is an act outside the organisation. The practice does not also grind the same order in house.
Pupil distance, segment height, and frame model come from the measuring task and are already on the practice record. This task does not measure them again and does not re-key them.
If sphere, cylinder, axis, eye, material, or pupil distance is blank, the draft produces no order and she finishes it inside the check.
A laboratory return is later rework. It is counted as one focal hour per 100 baseline hours, not inside the check.
The form does not choose a power. Whether copying stated fields is itself medical-purpose software is not decided here.
unknowns: Does this shop send every pair to an outside laboratory, or grind some pairs on an in-house bench?
research_questions: On one week of spectacle orders, what share of her time is retyping powers that were already on the record, as against deciding the material and the finishing instruction?

incremental.description: When the laboratory returns an order because a copied instruction was ambiguous, she re-states it. That hour is extra. It is not inside the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week of spectacle orders. Reading the prescription, choosing the material and the finishing, and checking every power stay. Assembly and the send shorten only when every required field was already stated. Weeks with many blank measurements or rewritten instructions sit at the low end. A returned order adds the counted hour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain the previous record or verify the prescription with the examiner.

steps.what: Read the customer's name and date of birth on today's appointment
outputs: customer name and date of birth

steps.what: Obtain the customer's previous record when one name and birthdate match
inputs: customer name and date of birth

steps.what: Decide whether the previous prescription can be used
Verify a prescription with the examining optometrist or ophthalmologist
outputs: powers the examiner confirmed, spoken on the call

steps.what: Check the powers to file match what the examiner said
inputs: powers the examiner confirmed, spoken on the call

steps.what: File the accepted prescription in the customer record

tasks.design: For a customer on today's appointment, {OTHER} opens the previous record when one name and date of birth match. Zero matches or more than one opens nothing, and a failed match is not treated as verified. She decides whether that prescription can be used. When she calls the examiner, she states the confirmed powers on the call and does not type them. She then checks that the powers match what the examiner said, not only the customer id. Only then does {OTHER} file that accepted prescription, and only when those powers were not already on the record. That file is the one keying into the dossier the next visit relies on. She does not also write the powers by hand, and no written request is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right previous record meant searching by hand, and a match on name alone can be the wrong person.
tasks.enabler_now: Name and date of birth are already on today's appointment, so one exact match can open the record without a search.
tasks.still_hard: Two people can share a name, and a prescription the examiner has not confirmed cannot be treated as usable.
tasks.human_edge: She judges whether the open prescription is the one this customer should wear.
tasks.altitude: She still decides whether a prescription can be used, and she still speaks to the examiner. The search and the keying of a new prescription shorten.

reach.task: Confirm the prescription powers on the phone
reach.learn: She records only what the examiner confirmed, after she checks the powers.

evidence.claim: Opening one record when name and date of birth match is a lookup. Keying a confirmed prescription into the customer record is work she does when those powers were not already stored. The phone call stays. No scribe-time figure is used. This is model knowledge.
The dossier is kept for 20 years, and the patient may ask who viewed it.
Health data are a special category.

assumptions: A written request to the examiner is not given a send step, because the usual path is the phone call.
The file step is the keying of a prescription that was not already on the record. She does not also type those powers by hand, and she does not re-file a prescription the open step already showed.
The examiner's time on the call is not her labour.
A failed match or a blank power is finished inside the decide and the check, so the upkeep allowance is zero.
Whether this shop's volume is large-scale processing is not known. The DPIA duty is named, not designed around.
unknowns: What share of customers have no previous record in this shop?
research_questions: On one week of appointments, how many previous records open on one exact name and date of birth, and how many still need the examiner's confirmation?

incremental.description: A failed match or a blank power is finished inside the decide and the check, which stay at full time. No upkeep hour is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week of appointments. The decision and the call stay. Opening a record shortens only when one name and date of birth match. Filing shortens only the keying of a prescription that was not already stored. Weeks where most customers have no local record sit at the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sell contact lenses, spectacles, sunglasses, and related goods.

steps.what: See which contact lenses, spectacles, and sunglasses are in reach
Sell goods such as contact lenses, spectacles, sunglasses, and goods related to eyes, in general

tasks.design: She sells contact lenses, spectacles, sunglasses, and related goods in the room. A product recommendation is not filed. Ringing the sale at the till is a separate counter step this task does not take, so no save of the sale is counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The sale is a conversation about what this customer will wear, and no recommendation note is a filing the task already does.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new is feasible here, because the work is the conversation in the shop.
tasks.still_hard: Which pair this customer will actually wear is visible only in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She notices which pair this customer will wear.
tasks.altitude: The sale stays hers. Nothing in the week moves.

reach.learn: The sale stays a conversation in the shop. She does not file a recommendation note.

evidence.claim: Selling these goods is spoken work in the shop. The digest does not show a recommendation note as a filing this task already does, so no file step is counted. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The talk with the customer in the shop is an internal act, not a message sent outside the organisation.
Taking payment is not part of this task, and no till keying is counted.
No system runs, so the upkeep allowance is zero.
unknowns: Is ringing the sale into the till part of this selling task, and how many minutes is that keying?
research_questions: On one week of sales, what share of her time is the conversation, as against keying a sale that other people later rely on?

incremental.description: No system runs on this task, so no upkeep hour is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week of sales in the shop. The look and the sale stay. A recommendation note is not counted, because a resident filing is not shown as work she already does.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week of showing lens care, stating the grind, looking up the old record, and selling stays. She no longer retypes powers that were already on the record, and she no longer searches by hand when one record matches.
reach: An examining optometrist or ophthalmologist confirms a prescription on the phone.
An optical laboratory technician grinds from the accepted work order.
The measuring task supplies pupil distance, segment height, and frame model before this order is prepared.
skills_to_grow: State the lens material, the coating, and the finishing instruction before any work order is drafted.
Reject an order whose powers differ from the prescription she read.
Leave the insertion demonstration and the sale in the room.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She still shows lens care, states the grind, checks the old record, and sells in the room.
